What Is Dining Room Design?

A dining room brings people together for daily meals and special occasions. Good design balances function, beauty and flow so every seat feels comfortable and the room connects naturally with the home.

We plan table placement, seating, lighting, colour, materials and finishes as one composition. Styling adds warmth while keeping sightlines across the table open.

What We Deliver

Every choice is coordinated around comfortable meals, clear movement and the character of your home.

Scroll through the full dining room scope.

01

Table & Seating Layout

Table size for your guest count, with room to pull out chairs and move comfortably.

02

Dining Table & Chair Selection

Shapes, materials and matching or coordinating chairs chosen for the room.

03

Statement Lighting

A chandelier or pendant cluster at the right height and scale above the table.

04

Colour Scheme Design

A cohesive palette with mood boards that make the room feel considered.

05

Decorative Styling

Art, mirrors, rugs and low centerpieces that never block conversation.

06

Material & Finish Selection

Walls, flooring, curtains and feature elements selected together.

07

Open-Plan Coordination

A defined dining zone that flows naturally into the kitchen or living room.

08

Small Dining Solutions & Storage

Round or extendable tables, wall lighting, mirrors and compact storage for dining essentials.

Our Design Process

Five focused stages take the room from conversation to a clear visual package.

01

Consultation & Requirements

We discuss daily meals, entertaining, guest count, style and budget.

02

Site Measurement

We record walls, openings and adjoining spaces for a precise fit.

03

Concept & Layout Design

Table placement, circulation and the dining mood come together.

04

Material & Furniture Selection

We choose the table, chairs, lighting, colour and finishes.

05

Final Design Package & 3D Visualization

You receive drawings, specifications and clear 3D views.

Consultation to final design packageTypically 1-2 weeks

Dining Room Design FAQs

Quick guidance on cost, proportion, lighting and timing.

The initial consultation is free. Design consultation starts from around PKR 12,000, while full packages range from PKR 15,000-35,000.

Allow about 24 inches per person and 36-48 inches around the table for chairs and comfortable movement.

A dining light usually hangs 30-36 inches above the table. We also size it in proportion to the tabletop.

The best palette responds to daylight, room size and mood. We coordinate walls, furniture, curtains and flooring.

A typical dining room takes 1-2 weeks from consultation to the final design package.

Yes. We define the dining zone and coordinate its layout, lighting and finishes with the kitchen and living areas.
